_comment: SYNTHETIC findings export in DefectDojo style. Targets are the local OWASP Juice Shop lab container only. No real engagement data.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search
findings.description: The q parameter of the product search endpoint is concatenated into a SQL query without sanitization, allowing UNION-based injection.
findings.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Browse to http://localhost:3000/#/search
2. Submit the payload qwert')) UNION SELECT id, email, password, '4', '5', '6', '7', '8', '9' FROM Users--
3. Observe user records rendered in the product grid

findings.title: Reflected XSS in search box
findings.description: Search input is reflected into the DOM without encoding, executing attacker-controlled markup.
findings.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Browse to http://localhost:3000/#/search?q=<iframe src="javascript:alert('xss')">
2. Observe the alert dialog firing

findings.title: Verbose error page discloses stack traces
findings.description: Requesting a malformed route returns a full Express stack trace, revealing framework internals and file paths.
findings.mitigation: Return a generic error page in production mode.
